name: templates
title: Free youth program form templates: registration, medical, pickup, waivers, policies and staff forms
description: BackPR's free printable PDF and editable Word templates for camps, after-school programs, childcare and other youth programs, with Spanish versions of the forms families fill out.
cite_as: BackPR (2026). Free youth program form templates: registration, medical, pickup, waivers, policies and staff forms (version 1.0, checked October 2026). https://backpr.com/data/templates.json. CC BY 4.0.
notes: A list of BackPR's free templates, with links to each PDF and Word file. CC BY 4.0 covers this list; the templates themselves are free to use and change without credit. They're starting points to adapt, not legal advice. Have a lawyer review waivers and agreements.

records.title: Youth program registration form
records.description: An all-in-one registration form for camps, after-school programs and classes: child and parent details, emergency contacts, pickup, health and payment.

records.title: Authorized pickup form
records.description: Lists every adult allowed to pick a child up and anyone who isn't, with the program's pickup rules. Keep a copy with each roster.

records.title: Medical and allergy form
records.description: Collects the allergy, medication and medical details staff need, plus emergency contacts and consent for emergency care.

records.title: Scholarship application
records.description: A short, respectful application for families who need help paying. Keep every answer confidential.

records.title: Field trip permission slip
records.description: A one-page permission slip for each trip: where, when, transportation and what to bring, with a parent signature and consent for emergency care.

records.title: Photo and media release
records.description: Lets families choose where photos, video and their child's first name may appear, from family updates to social media, and how to change their answer.

records.title: Participant code of conduct
records.description: Kid-friendly behavior expectations, what's never allowed and the steps staff take when rules are broken, signed by the child and a parent.

records.title: Camp packing list
records.description: A checklist to send families before camp starts: what to bring every day, on swim days and for overnight camp, plus what to leave at home.

records.title: Parent welcome letter
records.description: A friendly first letter with what families need before day one: dates, hours, drop-off and pickup, what to bring, health basics and how to reach you.

records.title: End-of-program parent survey
records.description: A one-page survey on what families liked, what to improve and whether they'll come back, with ratings you can count for your board and funders.

records.title: Late pickup policy agreement
records.description: Explains your closing time, late fees and the steps staff follow when a child isn't picked up, and gets each family's signature before the program starts.

records.title: Volunteer application
records.description: Screens volunteers before they work with children: roles, availability, references, background questions and agreement to your child protection rules.

records.title: Incident and accident report
records.description: A staff form for recording injuries, illnesses and behavior incidents the same day: what happened, first aid given, who was told and what you'll change.

records.title: Medication administration log
records.description: Records every dose of medicine staff give a child: date, time, dose, who gave it and any reaction. Use one log per child, per medicine.

records.title: Allergy alert roster
records.description: One page listing every child with an allergy, the signs of a reaction, what to do and where their medicine is, so any staff member can act fast.

records.title: Emergency action plan
records.description: A fill-in emergency plan for fire, severe weather, lockdown, a missing child, medical emergencies and reunification, with blanks for your site's details.

records.title: Daily sign-in and sign-out sheet
records.description: A daily log where adults sign children in and out with the time and their signature, and staff initial each pickup.

records.title: Weekly attendance sheet
records.description: A weekly attendance grid for one group, with daily marks and totals you can use for planning, billing and grant reports.

records.title: Counselor job description
records.description: A ready-to-edit job description for camp and after-school counselors: duties, qualifications, physical demands, schedule and pay.

records.title: Counselor interview questions
records.description: Interview questions for camp and after-school counselors, grouped by topic, with what a good answer shows and space to take notes and score each candidate.

records.title: Staff training checklist
records.description: Tracks each staff member's training: orientation, child protection, mandated reporting, emergencies, medication, first aid, pickup and confidentiality.

records.title: Parent handbook
records.description: An outline for your parent handbook with sample wording for each key policy, from hours and pickup to illness, behavior, payments and emergencies.

records.title: Staff handbook
records.description: An outline for your staff handbook with sample wording on pay, conduct, child protection, safety and confidentiality, ending with a signed acknowledgment.

records.title: Refund and cancellation policy
records.description: Sample refund and cancellation wording with options for deposits, deadlines, missed days, session changes, removals and program cancellations.

records.title: Scholarship policy
records.description: A sample scholarship policy: who's eligible, a sliding-scale example, how families apply, how you keep their information private and how you decide.

records.title: Camp daily schedule
records.description: A sample day camp schedule from drop-off to pickup, plus a blank weekly grid for planning each group's activities.

records.title: After-school daily schedule
records.description: A sample after-school schedule from school dismissal to pickup, with snack, homework, outdoor play and activities, plus a weekly planning grid.

records.title: Grant attendance report
records.description: A report for funders with program details, a monthly attendance table, outcomes and stories, plus how to count child-days and average attendance.

records.title: Childcare enrollment form and agreement
records.description: An enrollment form and parent agreement for daycares and childcare centers: child and family details, schedule, key policies and signatures.

records.title: Infant daily report
records.description: A daily sheet for each baby: feedings, naps, diapers, mood and notes, so families know how their baby's day went.

records.title: Child immunization and health record form
records.description: Keeps a child's vaccine dates, checkups and health screenings in one place for your childcare records, with space for a health care provider's signature.

records.title: Childcare tuition and fee agreement
records.description: A tuition agreement for daycares and childcare centers: rates, due dates, fees, late payments, rate changes and withdrawal notice, signed by each family.

records.title: Sick child policy
records.description: A fill-in illness policy for childcare: when children stay home, when you'll call families to pick up and when children can come back.

records.title: Infant safe sleep policy
records.description: A safe sleep policy for infant rooms, based on AAP and NICHD Safe to Sleep guidance: back to sleep, a bare crib, sleep checks and staff training.

records.title: Infant feeding plan
records.description: A feeding plan families fill out for each baby: breast milk or formula, amounts, hunger cues, solid foods and allergies, plus your bottle safety rules.

records.title: Medication authorization form
records.description: Parent permission for staff to give a child medicine: the medicine, dose, times and dates, signed before the first dose. Use it with the medication log.

records.title: Sunscreen and insect repellent permission form
records.description: Parent permission for staff to apply sunscreen and insect repellent, with the products to use, skin allergies and age limits from AAP and CDC guidance.

records.title: Diaper and toileting log
records.description: A daily log of diaper changes and toilet visits for each room: times, wet or soiled diapers, rashes, cream and staff initials, plus CDC's changing steps.

records.title: Emergency contact form
records.description: A one-page form for each child: parents, up to three emergency contacts, doctor, insurance and the health details staff need when something goes wrong.

records.title: Allergy action plan
records.description: A plan for one child with a serious allergy: what the child is allergic to, signs of a reaction, what staff do for mild and severe symptoms, and the doctor's sign-off.

records.title: Camp liability waiver (sample)
records.description: A sample release of liability and assumption of risk form for camps and youth activities, to adapt with your lawyer and insurer before you use it.

records.title: Camper behavior agreement
records.description: A short agreement between the camp, the camper and their family after repeated behavior problems: the goals, the support that staff will give and what happens next.

records.title: Camp bus and transportation permission form
records.description: Families say how their child gets to and from camp: bus stop, carpool, walking or biking home alone, and who may meet the bus.

records.title: Camp staff application
records.description: A job application for camp counselors and other seasonal staff: availability, experience with children, certifications, references and a background check notice.

records.title: Staff reference check form
records.description: A call script and notes form for checking a job candidate's references before you hire camp, after-school or childcare staff.

records.title: Swim test record
records.description: A lifeguard's sheet for recording each camper's swim test, the swim level or band they earned and where they may swim.

records.title: VBS registration form
records.description: A registration form for vacation Bible school: child, grade, parents, pickup, allergies, photo permission and a spot to sign up volunteers.

records.title: Camp health log
records.description: A daily log for the camp nurse or health staff: every visit, complaint, first aid, medicine given and whether the family was called.

records.title: Cabin and bunkmate request form
records.description: For overnight camps: families ask for a bunkmate, share sleeping needs and tell you what helps their camper settle in.

records.title: Camp store and spending money form
records.description: Families set a camp store (canteen) deposit, a daily limit and items their camper may not buy, and choose what happens to money left over.

records.title: Camp staff evaluation form
records.description: A mid-summer and end-of-summer review for counselors: safety, supervision, working with campers and staff, with goals and a rehire note.

records.title: Camper progress report
records.description: A short note to families at the end of a week or session: what their camper did, what they got better at, a friend or highlight, and something to try next time.

records.title: Camp staff schedule
records.description: A weekly grid for assigning counselors to groups, activity areas, breaks and duties like the bus, lunch and swim, so every group is covered.

records.title: Camp budget worksheet
records.description: A worksheet for planning a summer camp budget: staff, food, supplies, venue, insurance and other costs, against enrollment, fees and scholarships.

records.title: Summer camp planning checklist
records.description: A month-by-month checklist for running a summer camp, from setting dates and prices in the fall to hiring, registration, staff training and closing out the summer.

records.title: Get to know your camper questionnaire
records.description: A short questionnaire families fill out before camp so counselors know each child: interests, what helps them, worries, friendships and needs.

records.title: Head count and buddy check log
records.description: A sheet for recording head counts at every transition and buddy checks at swim, so staff can confirm every child is accounted for.

records.title: Camp staff code of conduct
records.description: Rules every counselor and volunteer agrees to: supervision, no one-on-one time out of sight, appropriate touch, phones and social media, and reporting concerns.
